levels.subtitle: Configure XP gain, manage level roles, and view the leaderboard.

stream_alerts.title: Stream Alerts
stream_alerts.subtitle: Post notifications when monitored channels go live.

stream_alerts.ping_roles_desc_free: Without Premium, one role applies to all platforms.

tickets.title: Tickets
tickets.subtitle: Manage ticket categories, post panels, and view open tickets.
tickets.log_channel_desc: If none is selected, the general log channel from settings is used.
tickets.category_form_note: The bot automatically creates the corresponding Discord category. After creation, the name can only be renamed directly, not the role selection in this form (use "Edit" on existing categories for that).
tickets.panel_section_desc: Posts a message with buttons for all current categories into a channel.
tickets.panel_warning: ⚠️ If you change a category later (name/delete), an already posted panel does not update automatically — repost it in that case.
tickets.description_placeholder: e.g. Choose a category below to create a ticket.
tickets.confirm_delete_category: Really delete this category? This also deletes the associated Discord category.
tickets.alert_title_desc_required: Please provide a title and description.

settings.subtitle: Server-wide base settings for the bot.
settings.no_active_premium: No active Premium subscription for this server.

settings.announcements_desc: Bot is allowed to post server announcements

boost.title: Boosts
boost.subtitle: Manage announcements for when someone boosts the server.

{server} now has **{count}** boost(s)!

reaction_roles.title: Reaction Roles
reaction_roles.subtitle: Manage role assignment via reactions. In "Unique" mode, roles within a group exclude each other.

reaction_roles.confirm_delete_message: Really delete all assignments for this message?
reaction_roles.alert_title_desc_required: Please provide a title and description.

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.subtitle: Manage welcome and goodbye messages.

moderation.title: Moderation
moderation.subtitle: Kick, ban, and timeout run through slash commands. Here you see an overview of currently banned and timed-out members.

automod.title: Automod
automod.subtitle: Automated moderation via Discord's native AutoMod engine plus the Nexus Anti-Nuke Shield.
automod.anti_spam_desc: Blocks automatically detected spam (Discord's spam detection).
automod.mention_spam_desc_suffix: mentions. The limit is currently fixed.
automod.anti_nuke_desc: Monitors audit logs with risk scoring against rapid server nukes.
automod.honeypot_desc: Anyone who posts in this channel is automatically timed out for {days} days.
automod.delete_honeypot_note: To change the name or warning text, the honeypot must be deleted and recreated.
automod.alert_honeypot_required: Please provide a channel name and warning text.
automod.confirm_delete_honeypot: Really delete the honeypot? The channel will also be removed.
